name: Lasher
description:
*By Triglav Games*

You are a master of a whip, and your weapon leaves gory marks on the bodies of your enemies. Even though you use a weapon of your enemies, you don't use it to subjugate others, but to punish those who do, and to liberate those enslaved by them.

features.name: Blood Streak
features.description: These will definitely leave scars...

ability.name: Blood Streak
ability.description: These will definitely leave scars...

roll.tier2: 5 + M or A damage; A < [average], bleeding (EoT)
roll.tier3: 8 + M or A damage; A < [strong], bleeding (save ends)

name: Mangler
description:
*By Triglav Games*

You are all muscle, no finesse. You focus on being as brutal as possible for you know there is no better enemy than a dead and mutilated one. Your clawed hands usually just graze your opponents, but once you land a solid hit, you mercilessly maim your prey.

features.name: Shred To Bits
features.description: When I am done with you, you will be but a lump of meat!

ability.name: Shred To Bits
ability.description: When I am done with you, you will be but a lump of meat!

roll.tier3: 9 + M damage; A < [strong], prone and bleeding (save ends)

name: Slasher
description:
*By Triglav Games*

You use your sharp, elongated claws to cut and tear your enemies, trying to injure as many as possible as fast as possible. You are fast and deadly, joining the fray immediately and relentlessly wounding your enemies.

features.name: Furious Lacerations
features.description: One more cut and you fall apart!

ability.name: Furious Lacerations
ability.description: One more cut and you fall apart!
ability.target: Up to three creatures or objects

sections.text: If you target two targets, this ability deals 2 extra damage to both of them. If you target only one target, this ability deals extra damage equal to 3 + your Might or Agility score.

name: Ace
description: You fight with one hand on a blade and the other on a pistol, weaving steel and smoke into a single deadly style. Aces are fast, aggressive duelists who thrive in close quarters, darting in for a cut, a shot, or both before their enemy can recover. Some are privateers, raiders, and sellswords; others are officers, smugglers, or urban swashbucklers with a taste for flair.

features.name: Point Blank Shot
features.description: A slash, a step, and a pistol shot delivered at breath-stealing range.

ability.name: Point Blank Shot
ability.description: A slash, a step, and a pistol shot delivered at breath-stealing range.

roll.tier2: 5 + M or A damage; you can shift 1
roll.tier3: 7 + M or A damage; you can shift 1; if the target is adjacent to you, push 2

sections.text: When using this ability, you ignore the penalty for making ranged attacks while adjacent to an enemy.

name: Heavy Gunner
description: You haul a brutal, oversized firearm built to chew through anything unlucky enough to stand in the open. Heavy gunners trade finesse for force, laying down punishing bursts, driving enemies back, and controlling the field through sheer volume of shot. Whether braced behind rubble, marching forward under recoil, or sweeping a street clear with sustained fire, you are the answer to massed resistance.

features.name: Strafe
features.description: You sweep a lane of fire across the battlefield, driving enemies back under a storm of shot.

ability.name: Strafe
ability.description: You sweep a lane of fire across the battlefield, driving enemies back under a storm of shot.

sections.text: The targets are force moved one at a time, starting with the target nearest to you, and can be pushed into other targets in the same line.
Before you use this ability, you can use your maneuver to brace; if you do so, you gain an edge on your power roll.

name: Ironsight
description: Carrying a long rifle, you rely on discipline, timing, and a well-placed shot instead of theatrics. Ironsight fighters are marksmen, hunters, and soldiers trained to make every round count, punishing exposed targets and dropping enemies before they can close the distance. You don’t need fancy tricks—just a steady hand, a clear line, and the patience to fire at exactly the right moment.

features.name: Deadeye
features.description: You aim your shot where armor parts and cover fails.

ability.name: Deadeye
ability.description: You aim your shot where armor parts and cover fails.

sections.text: This strike ignores cover and concealment. If the target has no cover or concealment, this strike deals extra damage equal to your Agility score.

name: Pistolier
description: You fight with speed, nerve, and absolute confidence in the weapon at your hip. Pistoliers excel in close-to-mid-range exchanges, snapping off shots, repositioning, and turning a sidearm into the centerpiece of a duelist’s style. Some are officers and detectives, some are gamblers and hired guns, but all of them know that one quick shot at the right moment can decide the fight.

features.name: Fan the Hammer
features.description: Your pistol fires a second shot before your foes even realize there’s been a first one.

ability.name: Fan the Hammer
